title: Did the tribes fight? Mardi Gras violence
summary: Asked about fighting and Jelly Roll Morton's account, Cahn recalls Mardi Gras as a day of revenge with shootings and knifings, but cannot verify weapons laws.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
